explanation: On one reading the unilateral declaration eight months later was the movement's answer to the killing: proof that the PAIGC had survived the loss of its founder, and a way of turning international sympathy into recognition while it was still fresh.

dispute.text: Others hold the declaration was already prepared before Cabral died — the elections to the assembly that proclaimed it had been planned, and the military position in the interior was what made it credible — so the assassination changed the timing at most, not the decision.
